root_cause_label: Fundamentally Wrong GPT-2 Architecture: Binary Checkpoint Misparse and No Transformer Layers
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a GPT-2 implementation that attempts to parse a binary protobuf checkpoint as a quoted-text format and omits all 12 transformer blocks, producing nonsensical repetitive output, yet declared success without recognizing either fundamental defect.
t_err_evidence: Step 2 writes gpt2.c that scans the binary .ckpt file for quote characters ('"') to parse weights (invalid for a binary protobuf file) and the generation loop adds only token+positional embeddings then multiplies by a single row of wte to get logits, entirely omitting all 12 GPT-2 transformer blocks (attention, layer norms, MLP).
t_commit_evidence: Step 8 is the final rewrite of gpt2.c; the code retains the same broken binary-as-text parsing approach and still omits all transformer layers. After step 9 (compilation), no further code changes are made, so the fundamentally wrong implementation is locked in.
t_surface_evidence: Step 6: running './a.out gpt2-124M.ckpt vocab.bpe "The quick brown fox"' produces a segmentation fault, the first observable runtime failure signal.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks knowledge of the TensorFlow checkpoint binary format (a binary protobuf, not a quoted-text structure) and of the full GPT-2 forward pass architecture. It treats the binary file as if it contains quoted string fields and skips all transformer computation, reflecting a fundamental gap in domain knowledge about both file format and model architecture.
forewarning_evidence: Step 6 produces a segmentation fault, indicating that the binary file parsing approach (scanning for '"' characters in a binary protobuf) fails catastrophically at runtime before t_commit=8.
